retained_whole_regions.whole_region_utf8: let disconnected=false;const disconnect=new Promise(r=>browser.once('disconnected',()=>{disconnected=true;r();}));const session=await browser.newBrowserCDPSession();await bound(session.send('Browser.close'),10000,'Actual owned Browser.close protocol acknowledgment');await bound(disconnect,15000,'Owned browser disconnected');await bound(chrome.close,15000,'Owned Chrome natural close');natural(chrome,0);assert(disconnected);browser=null;proof.chrome_shutdown={protocol_acknowledged:true,disconnected:true,natural_exit:chrome.exit};
